hard_fix_round.source: Greptile P1 review (tip_match 0/5) on PR #47, tip a38454de6dab84124b7be8f99d64418d9d12224f
fixed: metavr_bridge.py: connection flag was a hardcoded False constant only a test hook could flip, so MetaVR actions could never actually run in production. Replaced with a real `adb devices -l` query (_device_connected), with an explicit test-only override hook (set_device_connected/reset_device_override).

cli.py: nonzero adb return codes from install_apk, instrumented_run, screenshot, and logcat_capture were reported via _print_skip (exit 0). Added _print_fail, which prints to stderr and propagates the real adb exit code, reserved for cases where the binary actually ran and failed (vs. _print_skip for missing binary/device).

cli.py logcat_capture: --out was written before checking the subprocess return code, so a failed capture could clobber a previously-good log. Reordered to check the return code first and only write on success.

cli.py logcat_capture: --seconds was ignored; the adb backend always ran `logcat -d` (instant dump). Now seconds>0 runs a live `adb logcat` stream via Popen, capped with communicate(timeout=seconds), so the duration is actually respected.

gradle.py: unit_test appended the raw module filesystem path (e.g. 'android/app') as a second positional gradle arg after 'test', which Gradle reads as an unknown task name rather than a project scope. Added module_task() to convert it into a proper ':android:app:test' task reference.

cli.py: --gradle-args used nargs='*', which argparse cannot combine with flag-like values (e.g. --offline) — they get rejected as unrecognized arguments. Switched to nargs=argparse.REMAINDER so --gradle-args captures everything after it verbatim (documented as needing to be the last flag).

cli.py emu_boot: declared 'emulator started' unconditionally after a blind sleep (or not at all when --timeout-sec was 0), regardless of whether the spawned process was still alive. Added a bounded poll loop on proc.poll() so an immediate crash is reported as a real failure instead of false success.
